title: HTTP success with empty context and retry amplification
description: A retrieval request returns transport success while yielding empty context; the guarded path records the semantic outcome, stays within bounds, and escalates.

metadata.purpose: Teach and test the distinction between transport success and task outcome without exporting payloads or live telemetry.

requirements.description: Call the synthetic retrieval tool for the workflow.
Observe the transport-level success returned by retrieval.
Escalate when the transport succeeds but usable context is absent.
Record task outcome separately from transport status.
Correlate all observations to one bounded workflow identifier.
Stay within the declared retry ceiling.
Stay within the declared estimated-cost ceiling.
Do not report success when the context is empty.
